integrity: The theorem is supported by a mathematical proof and an included standalone exact-rational/numerical checker. Computational tests corroborate, but do not replace, the infinite asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic equilibrium comparison across integer migration-round counts, not temporal periodicity or demographic stochasticity. The asymptotic onset index is unspecified. The sharp two-patch obstruction assumes positive analytic concave recruitment and noncritical perfect mixing. The statement is literature-bounded and lacks an independent historical-priority review.
title: Six-phase crossings of carrying capacity under repeated three-habitat dispersal
